searchText: when do we wanna have this in? This seems like a very small change. Maybe we can wait for this for glamsterdam-devnet-1? is the pr 5152 only an issue for lightclients? More like an optimization for light clients. So yes, this is not important for devnet-0. But since I’ve already merged it, if for whatever reason we need another release for devnet0, it will be included in that. Yeah seems very minor, curious what cl devs think. I think we could include it in devnet 0 but also don’t wanna keep pushing the start line cc <@&1417820113981145228> the main outcome I want to avoid is overlapping specs i.e. maintaining multiple branches for alpha.5/6 so ok with doing it for neither devnet-0/1 or both devnet 0/1 I think we will have a chance to be agile in the coming days, so I'd just push for the new alpha 6 release and aim to have clients implement this tiny extra field. But ideally the genesis handling issue should be resolved also is there a proposed pr to fix the genesis issue? I don’t want to change specs right as everyone is getting things working. I’m leaning towards not doing anything until there’s a better reason to make a release. I wish I had waited to merge that breaking change 😓 Not that I’m aware of. not sure about the spec but wasn't to hard to get this working in lodestar https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/9273 apart form that you only need this check in `processWithdrawals` ```ts // Return early if this is genesis block or the parent block is empty if (fork >= ForkSeq.gloas) { const stateGloas = state as CachedBeaconStateGloas; const isGenesisBlock = byteArrayEquals(stateGloas.latestBlockHash, ZERO_HASH); const isParentBlockEmpty = !isParentBlockFull(stateGloas); if (isGenesisBlock || isParentBlockEmpty) { return; } } ``` AFAICT There's nothing necessarily broken, other than the `is_genesis_block` variable name, which is semantically incorrect. The issue is stating a valid mismatch between the state initialized with the test genesis helper and the spec checks. Laid out more details on the issue, happy to discuss anytime. I'd rather not have this change in the devnet-0 It may affect proposer code and make us grab the block No change is "really small" until it's coded Yeah I agree. If we need to make a release this week, would you suggest we revert this change first? I don't mind if there's a release, as long as it doesn't make it to the devnet I mean that’s the only reason I’d make a release; some fix for the devnet. Let’s hope that’s not necessary.
